visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a mouth-watering close-up of a pink watermelon-flavored shaved ice dessert topped with small fruit balls, followed by a sequence of a silver fork slicing through a golden-brown, sugar-dusted French toast. (2) The scene shifts to a hotpot setting where creamy white milk is poured into a bubbling red Mexican chili soup base from a glass bottle, and a piece of thin-sliced meat is swirled in the savory broth using metal tongs. (3) A new phase shows a vibrant green basil-nut soup base being enriched with milk, creating a creamy texture, while fresh vegetable platters and colorful side dishes are displayed on the table. (4) The focus moves to high-quality raw meat platters featuring marbled American bacon beef and Angus black beef, arranged neatly on white marble slabs alongside boiling pots. (5) Next, the camera highlights a variety of desserts and drinks, including a close-up of the French toast's creamy interior, a tall chocolate smoothie with whipped cream, and a refreshing watermelon ice drink decorated with a fruit pick. (6) A savory side dish of crispy hash brown-like pancakes is dipped into a creamy orange sauce and wrapped in seaweed. (7) The final phase shows pink shaved ice being poured into a bowl, followed by wide panning shots of the restaurant's modern interior and its bright storefront sign at night.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice begins with moderate arousal, introducing the hotpot restaurant against a background of upbeat, major-mode electronic pop music. (2) A clear liquid splash sound marks the pouring of milk into the soup, accompanied by rhythmic synthesizer beats and steady speech. (3) The narrator's pitch rises slightly as he recommends the Italian basil soup, with the BGM maintaining a constant high-energy tempo of roughly 124 BPM. (4) Distinct metallic clinks of tongs and plates are audible during the description of beef varieties, while the music stays consistent without structural pauses. (5) As the topic shifts to desserts like French toast, the vocal tone becomes more animated, supported by percussive drum hits in the music track. (6) The final phase features a concluding greeting with a slightly falling intonation, as the upbeat BGM remains the dominant acoustic bed until the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unique Soup Bases -> Meat Quality -> Dessert/Drinks Highlights -> Store Info
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'Ertang Hotpot' restaurant in Kaohsiung by showcasing its unique milk-infused fusion soup bases (Mexican and Italian), premium Angus beef, and surprisingly professional-grade desserts like French toast and shaved ice. It targets late-night diners and foodies looking for a comprehensive dining experience that balances savory hotpot with high-quality sweets.
